senses.definition: n.[m.] tip, i.e. lobe of ear (𝔊 λοβὸς τοῦ ὠτός, 𝔙 extremum auriculae, and so most ancient authorities, cf. Thes1511);—cstr. in phr. תּ׳ אֹזֶן פ׳ Ex 29:20(×2) Lv 8:23, 24; 14:14, 17, 25, 28 (all P).
